set.description: 点 (x0，y0) 到直线 Ax+By+C=0 的距离是 |Ax0+By0+C| 除以 √(A²+B²)。
set.name: Distance from a point to a line

set.description: 把方程一边化为 0，另一边分解成一次因式的积，利用“若 ab=0 则 a=0 或 b=0”求解。
set.name: Factoring Method
scopeNotes: Factoring here is an equation-solving procedure, not the entire factor-sign method for inequalities.

set.description: 从圆外一点引圆的两条切线，切线长相等，圆心与该点的连线平分两切线的夹角。
set.name: Tangent Length Theorem

criteria: 知道横坐标相同的两点连线没有斜率
set.description: 过不同两点 (x1，y1)、(x2，y2) 的直线，在 x1≠x2 时斜率为 (y2−y1)/(x2−x1)。
set.name: Slope formula for a line through two points

criteria: 能写出三个比的表达式
理解其值只与角的大小有关
set.description: 在直角三角形中，锐角的正弦、余弦、正切分别是对边比斜边、邻边比斜边、对边比邻边。
set.name: Definitions of Trigonometric Functions of Acute Angles

criteria: 知道分母为 0 时公式不能用
set.description: 会用正切的和差公式计算分母不为 0 的特殊值。
set.name: Tangent of the Sum and Difference of Two Angles

criteria: 能说出垂线段最短的依据
能指出并度量点到直线的距离
set.description: 直线外一点与直线上各点的连线中垂线段最短，垂线段的长度叫点到直线的距离。
set.name: The perpendicular segment is shortest and the distance from a point to a line
set.nameZh: 垂线段最短与点到直线的距离

set.scope: meaning of the computed distance

set.scope: substituting into Ax+By+C form

set.reason: Computing the perpendicular foot and its length avoids the closed coefficient formula.
set.scope: compute d by the closed coefficient formula

criteria: 能计算圆心到直线的距离
能根据 d 与 r 判断位置关系
set.description: 圆心到直线的距离 d 与半径 r 比较：d<r 相交，d=r 相切，d>r 相离。
set.name: Relative Positions of a Line and a Circle
